name: Nimbus
product: Nimbus is a work-management and team-collaboration platform: projects, tasks, dashboards, and automations in one place, where teams plan, track, and ship work.
customers: Small and mid-market teams (marketing, product, operations, agencies, and software teams) in the United States and the European Union, including healthcare and financial customers who ask for the SOC 2 report before they buy.
size_tier: 100 to 249 employees; SB 2610 tier requiring NIST CSF or ISO/IEC 27001
plain: Nimbus is a made-up software company whose product helps teams plan and track their work, invented so this site can show what a complete security and AI governance program looks like for a small Texas business. The two customer-facing AI assistants it runs are real and can be tried, but the company, its staff, its customers, and its numbers are simulated.
